title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 天气气候 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）
meta: 主题语境：天气气候（人与自然·自然生态·天气与气候）　|　核心词汇：rainbow　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rainbow 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the ranger ① saw the rainbow that no villager in the valley would have recorded, and he said the seeing was the whole of the season. The ② rainbow, meaning the arc itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a rainbow, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ rainbow in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ rainbow at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A rainbow, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the ranger said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the rainbow was the whole of the matter, meaning the hope and not the arc. The ⑥ rainbow, meaning the hope and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; rainbow, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both an arc and a hope. He said the hope is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ rainbow had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ rainbow of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of recording; rainbow, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ rainbow I remember is the arc recorded in the survey, which closed in 1985 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ rainbow, my mother said in 1987, is the only arc that improves by being recorded; every rainbow, she said, is a hope that has agreed to look like an arc. She said the hope was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 彩虹（指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道）
B. n. 彩虹（指那道彩虹本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：see the rainbow 望见这一道彩虹
D. n. 彩虹（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 彩虹之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的彩虹之事）
F. n. 彩虹（指踏勘记录里写到、被记载的那一道）
G. n. 彩虹、盼望（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 盼望（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: saw the rainbow that no villager in the valley would have recorded
The rainbow, meaning the arc itself and not the staff
the rainbow at the far ridge
the rainbow was the whole of the matter
the rainbow had become a line in a survey
The rainbow of the whole thing
A rainbow, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: see the rainbow 意为“望见这一道彩虹”，1978 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯记载的一道彩虹做了一遍。
rainbow 意为“彩虹”，指那道彩虹本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被记载。
rainbow 意为“彩虹”，指山谷里每一道旁边的那一道，每一道旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
rainbow 意为“彩虹”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
rainbow 意为“彩虹、盼望”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这道盼望就是那件事的全部。
rainbow 意为“盼望”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那道彩虹，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
rainbow 意为“彩虹”，指踏勘记录里写到、被记载的那一道，到 1983 年这一道成了踏勘记录里的一行。
rainbow 意为“彩虹之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的彩虹之事是一处山谷和三个季节的记载。
rainbow 意为“彩虹”，我记得的是踏勘记录里记载过的那一道，1985 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一道。
rainbow 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，彩虹是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的彩虹。
